decisionsTitle: The home page, phase 3: a real page at the root with its eight sections, off until the club says yes
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10**, deciding the redesign plan's decision 3: a real home page at `/ro` and `/en`, reached from the logo — never a menu entry — switchable on and off in «Aspect» → «Pagina principală»; and his standing rule of the same day: component-based, one named Server Component per section with typed props, each drawn on `/admin/design` → «Mostre», everything the club sees a setting. **The owner, 2026-10-11:** «start the homepage now, with empty photo slots and the plan's defaults», behind its own switch, which stays off. Phase 3 of `docs/REDESIGN.md` was three chains: part A (the page, its setting, the hero, the next run and the run sections), part B (`feat/home-sections`: «Prima dată», «De ce», the photo strip and the numbers as components, its own entry) and part C, which wired those four into the page and its setting, folded the panel and closed both parts' review points. This section is parts A and C, landed on one branch: after it the home page is complete behind its switch, ready for the club's photographs and words on QA. Amends §353 (the root is no longer the proxy's 308), §251 (the front page is the events — while the setting is off), §319 (the round arrow, on the home page's cards only) and §692 (the plan's rows).

**Decision — the setting, «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală».** A fourth card beside the tint, the text size and «Aspectul nou», in their shape: two radios, «Lista de alergări» (the default) and «Pagina principală»; the hero's photograph, chosen like every picture in the house (`TeamPhotoField` under its own stem, `hero`: the upload with its quality choice, «Din galerie», the crop box starting at the largest 16∶9); the hero's two lines, the headline and the line under it, Romanian and English or neither (§352) — an empty pair draws the site's own words from the catalogue (`Home.hero.*`), never the other language's; the labels of the hero's three buttons («Vino cu noi» → the next weekly run, «Vezi calendarul» → the calendar, both with the platform's own words when empty, and «Cum funcționează» → a club page, below), each label Romanian and English or neither; and the page's eight switches: `hero`, `nextRun`, `weekly` and `special` (on) and `steps`, `why`, `strip` and `numbers` (off by default, until the club has filled each and ticks it). «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» (§464, §482, the pattern of §697) sits over the pairs: the allowlist gains `headlineEn`, `sublineEn`, `buttonJoinEn`, `buttonCalendarEn` and `buttonHowEn`. Save behind the §384 question, the Administrator's alone (`canManageClubSettings`, asserted at the page, the action and the service), audited as `home_page.changed` under its own entity id (by switch, by picture id and whether cropped, whether the words or buttons changed and whether the sections did — never the words, an address or a file name), stored as one `platform_settings` row (`homePage`) with no migration (§100). The save reads the picture's key prefix and size from the store and keeps them in the row beside its id, as an event's `cover` carries them (§709), so the public read asks the store nothing; a picture that is not in the store or is a film's poster (§485) is refused, naming «Fotografia de sus». The row's text names the picture, so the orphan sweep and a delete from the pictures page keep it, and the pictures page lists it as used «Pe pagina principală» (`media/references.ts`, the team introduction's rule, §474). A save expires the public cache's settings (§549). With no row, or one this code cannot read, it is off: the root leads to the listing as it always did. The four lower sections' contents live in the same row (below); every field is optional, so a row written by an older form stays readable. **A save and a strip change never overwrite each other:** the page's save and the strip's three forms read the row, merge and write it in one transaction under one advisory lock, and expire the public cache only after the commit. **The row is read loosely and written over what was there:** a key this code does not know (a later release's, after a rollback) is kept on read and carried through a save, never read as «off» and never dropped; a save from a form that does not carry the buttons or the switches keeps them as they were.

**Decision — the root (amends §353).** `app/[locale]/page.tsx` is a static page (§549: `revalidate` 86400, no `searchParams`), not the proxy's: the proxy cannot read a setting without waking the database on the site's most-visited address, so it now lets `/ro` and `/en` through. The page reads the setting through the public cache. **Off**, it answers `redirect` to the listing: a **307**, not §353's 308, because a browser keeps a permanent redirect for good, and a visitor who had once opened the root would keep landing on the listing after the club switched the page on. Decided in a prerender, the redirect is a real status line with its `Location`, kept by the CDN with the page's lifetime and made again when the setting is saved. Its body is Next's own document for such a redirect (about 66 KB before compression), which a browser never shows: §353's empty body needs a proxy redirect, which needs the setting at the proxy. The query is not carried to the listing — one static answer serves every query; nothing reads one there. The 307 (with the dropped query, the two hops for `/` and the redirect document's body) was decided by the dispatcher on 2026-10-11, because a permanent redirect is cached by browsers and would hide the home page once switched on; BR-REQ-040-01 criterion 9 (308, the query kept, one hop) is replaced by the criterion below. **Browsers that cached §353's 308** (since 2026-09-24) keep going straight to the listing for `/ro` and `/en` until their cache clears, so a returning visitor will not see the home page the day the switch is turned on; a new visitor, a private window or a cleared cache does. `/` is next-intl's again: a 307 to `/ro` (the one-hop retarget of §353 would now skip the home page), so while off a visit to `/` takes two hops. **On**, the root is the home page, canonical to itself in each language with the other as its alternate, and carries the club's `SportsOrganization` block (BR-REQ-052-02 criterion 1: the homepage). The proxy treats `/ro` and `/en` as static answers (`live-twin.ts`'s patterns, `prefetch.ts`'s list gains `/`), so off Vercel the browser is told what Vercel's CDN tells it. **The check is in `yarn smoke`:** after the health answer it asks `/ro` and `/en` twice each, without following redirects, and fails on anything but a 307 to the listing or the home page's 200 — never a 308, never a 200 that is an error document (§353: a redirect thrown from a page once reached production that way): the body of a 200 is read and must carry `data-testid="home-page"` and no `__next_error__` (the verdict is one pure function, `judgeRoot`, with a unit test), while a 307 passes as long as the setting is off, which is the default — and prints `x-vercel-cache`, which must read `HIT` on the second answer of a 307 (watch it by eye after the QA deploy: it rests on Next's prerendered redirect staying a 307 on Vercel's CDN, seen so far only on `next start`).

**Decision — the logo, the sitemap and the menu (amends §251, §342).** While the setting is on, the header's logo leads to `/` (`LogoLink` takes the address from `SiteHeader`, which reads the setting from the public cache beside the look), and the sitemap lists `/ro` and `/en` at priority 1 and the listing at 0.9. Off, both are what they were: the logo to the listing, no root in the sitemap (a redirecting URL is a defect there), the listing at 1. The menu has no entry for the home page at all (decision 3): «Alergări» stays the listing at its address, the calendar its tab.

**Decision — the sections (part A), each a Server Component with typed props under `src/modules/home/ui/`.** No element-valued prop (§370), colour only from the theme and `brand.ts` tokens (§694), no island: the links are the house's `Link` and `ArrowButtonLink`.

- **`HomePage`** — the one `main`; the hero, the next run, the weekly runs, the special events, then «Prima dată» (`StepsBand`), «De ce» and the quote (`WhyList`), the photo strip (`PhotoStrip`) and the numbers band (`NumbersBand`), in the plan's order; a last good copy says so above the hero (§281).
- **`HomePage`** draws a section only while its switch is on (a switch the props leave out is the setting's default: the first four on, the lower four off), and a section with nothing true to show draws nothing — `RunCardGrid` with no cards, the strip with no picture, the numbers with no figure: no heading over an empty row and no sentence about none (the `empty` words are gone from both catalogues). Hiding the hero keeps the page's one `h1`: a visually hidden one first in `main`, carrying the headline's words (or the club's name), so the page is never without a heading for a screen reader or an outline.
- **`Hero`** — the page's one `h1` with its last word in the accent (`splitHeadline`: a `span` in `primary`, pink under «Aspectul nou», never a gradient), the line under it, «Vino cu noi» (the next weekly run's page, else the listing — decision 5, the header button's own target), «Vezi calendarul» and, once the club has chosen its page, «Cum funcționează» (that page, at its address in the reader's language) as `ArrowButtonLink` pills, each label the club's or the platform's own, and the club's photograph: words first on a phone so the first screen at 320 pixels is the heading and the buttons, side by side from `md`. The photograph is the page's one eager picture, `fetchpriority="high"`, with the ladder's `srcset` for a new `hero` column (`media/ladder.ts`: half the page from `md`, 728 at its widest); every other picture is lazy.
- **`NextRunCard` — «Următoarea alergare».** The soonest date still going ahead of a group run or a race (open question 7's default: the soonest run; the featured flag keeps marking the race on the listing; a hike or a coffee is never «the next run»; none ahead, no card): its cover, the kind's tag over it, the title as the link over the whole card, when, where, the forecast's words at the start from Open-Meteo's condition code (open question 6's default, §402, read with the listing's own `forecastsForEvents`) and the day's sunset at its place («Apus la …», `sun.ts`), and the round arrow.
- **`RunCardGrid`** — the weekly runs and the special events, split by `eventKind` (§709, decision 9), one card per series shown by its next date still going ahead (§113; a series whose every date ahead is cancelled is no card), at most six a section, soonest first; a weekly card says its rhythm («În fiecare marți, la 18:30») and its next date, a special one its date and place. **A carousel without an island:** on a phone a CSS scroll-snap strip that scrolls inside itself, the next card's edge showing; three to a row from `md`. «Vezi toate alergările» to the listing under the special events (and under the weekly runs when there are more than six).
- **The parts:** `HomePicture` (the 16∶9 frame, the crop drawn as the team's photographs draw theirs, §541, or the **empty slot**: the frame with the mountain mark, faint — never a stock or generated picture, decision 6), `RunTag` (the kind's word beside its glyph from the public registry; the pills' colours belong to «Aspectul nou» as phase 2's `coverTag` says — `accentTint`/`accentInk` for a weekly run and `kindSpecial`/`kindSpecialInk` for a special event, each with its dark twin, all held at AA by `LOOK_PAIRS`, written under the look's scope (`UNDER_LOOK`); with the look off the pill is the theme's own neutral (`action.selected`, `text.primary`) so the page keeps today's palette; state never by colour alone), `RoundArrow` (decision 10's default: a 44-pixel round arrow on the home page's cards only, a picture inside the card's one link, `aria-hidden` — amends §319 on this page alone; the listing keeps its text door), `card-sx.ts` (16-pixel radius, one soft shadow, the title's link stretched over the card with the card's focus ring, §486).

**Decision — the four lower sections in the setting (part C).** The `homePage` row gains `steps`, `why`, `strip` and `numbers`, each read by part B's own schema (`modules/home/domain/`), and each that no longer reads is its empty value — the platform's words, no picture, no figure — never the page off. The form posts every box as a pair `<stem>Ro` / `<stem>En` (`appearance/domain/home-sections-form.ts`: «Prima dată»'s heading, sentence, five steps (a title and a sentence each, as a reason of «De ce» is) and button; «De ce»'s heading, four reasons, quote and its author; the strip's heading), both languages or neither (§352), and a refusal names the box the club must fix — the empty side of a pair, or the box over its length — never a path inside the stored value; the founding day is a date box and «alergători activi» a whole number from 1, empty for none. Each fold carries a marker, so a save from a form that did not show a section keeps it as it was. The audit row says whether the lower sections changed (`contentChanged`), never their words or figures. «Copiază și tradu tot» fills their English boxes: the allowlist gains `stepsTitleEn`, `stepsLeadEn`, `step1TitleEn`…`step5BodyEn`, `stepsLinkEn`, `whyTitleEn`, `why1TitleEn`…`why4BodyEn`, `quoteEn`, `quoteByEn` and `stripTitleEn`, never the two figures.

**Decision — «Cum funcționează» opens a club page chosen by its id (reverses part A's typed address).** A page's address differs between the languages (`page_translations` is unique by locale and slug), so a typed address was the Romanian page's on the English page too — a 404 or another page. The hero's third button and the band's button each name one of «Pagini personalizate» from a list (a draft is marked as such), and the page resolves it at its own address in the reader's language from the navigation's own cached list of published pages; a page not published in that language is no button, never a broken link. The hero's label is optional now, like the band's: empty, the platform's «Cum funcționează» (`Home.hero.how`); words with no page are refused, naming the choice. A row in part A's shape (`how` with a slug) reads as no third button. **Drafts are allowed at save, a deliberate change from the first brief** (which refused a page with no published translation): the club may choose a page it is still writing, the panel marks it as a draft, and the button appears the day the page is published, never before. The page list is read once per render the way the header reads it — the navigation's cached list with its last good copy behind it (§447), and an empty list when even that fails — so an outage drops a button, never the root.

**Decision — the strip's pictures keep their facts in the setting, chosen by forms of their own.** Each picture of the strip is kept with its key prefix and size beside its id, copied from the store when it is added, as the hero's photograph is — so the public read asks the store nothing, and the pictures page and the orphan sweep, which look for a picture's key prefix in the setting's text, see it used («Pe pagina principală»). Part B's design had the page read the ids from `media_assets` at each render; the row's facts replace it (no `pictureIds`, no `orderStripPictures`). The pictures are added («Din galerie» or an upload, no crop: the square tile shows each picture's middle — `TeamPhotoField` gains `noCrop`), moved a place (↑ «Mai sus» / ↓ «Mai jos») and taken out («Scoate», asked first) by small forms of their own in a fold after the page's form, like a product's pictures (§697): a form cannot sit inside another, and a slow upload never holds the page's boxes hostage. Each is the Administrator's (`changeStripPicture`, asserted at the action and the service), audited as `home_page.changed` by the picture's id and the change, and expires the public cache's settings; a picture not in the store, a film's poster (§485), one already in the strip or a thirteenth is refused, and a second press that has nothing to move or remove writes nothing. The page's own save never touches the pictures. Each tile is read as «Fotografie de la alergările clubului, 2 din 6» (`HomeSections.strip.photoAlt`).

**Decision — «Prima dată» says «Prima dată la noi?», and its steps have titles.** Each of the five steps is a short title over one sentence (both languages or neither per box: `step{n}Title`, `step{n}Body`), the platform's defaults carrying both (`HomeSections.steps.items.N.title` / `.body`), the heading reading «Prima dată la noi?» («First time with us?»).

**Decision — the numbers band states only what the calendar says.** «Alergări pe săptămână» sums the weekdays of the weekly **group-run** series ahead (a weekly coffee, hike or meetup is no run), and a series whose coming dates are all cancelled adds nothing; «100%» is drawn only when every coming date of those series that is still going ahead says «Gratuit», which is what its label «alergările de grup, gratuite» claims.

**Decision — the panel in folds.** Under the choice and one «Copiază și tradu tot», one fold per part of the page, closed on arrival with a line that says what is in it (§336, the owner's «folds closed by default with a summary line»): «Ce secțiuni arată pagina» («5 din 8 arătate»), «Sus: fotografia, titlul și butoanele» («Cu fotografie» / «Fără fotografie»), «Prima dată» and «De ce și citatul» («Textele clubului» / «Textele implicite»), the strip's heading and «Cifrele clubului» («1 din 2 completate»), each box showing the platform's sentence as its grey placeholder, so an empty box says what the page will draw; then «Fotografiile benzii» («3 fotografii»), opened by itself after its own save. A refusal opens the fold that holds its box (`ActionForm`, §315). The switches no longer say «încă nu există».

**What it costs.** Nothing new is asked of the database: the page reads the listing's own cached upcoming events (`cachedUpcomingEvents`, held to its clock window) under a last-good key of its own, the forecast's cached hour, and the setting the root already read. It is static — made again when the setting is saved, an event is written or ends, at the forecast's hour, and at the latest after a day. The header reads one more cached setting on every page. Part C adds no read of its own: the lower sections are in the same row, the club page comes from the navigation's cached list, the Instagram from the footer's one list (§565), and the numbers from the same upcoming events the cards read. No new client component, no new dependency, no new font; the glyphs are inline SVG drawn on the server. **Measured** on a production build (2026-10-11, the sample data, no photograph chosen), at 320 pixels with the CPU slowed four times and a 1.6 Mbit/s, 150 ms network: the home page's largest paint 0.96–1.13 s (the line under the heading), the listing's 1.19–1.69 s under the same conditions. The gate's measurement with the club's photograph in the hero is QA's.

**The design page.** «Mostre» gains «Pagina principală · Hero, NextRunCard, RunCardGrid»: the components the root draws, from the sample rows (`design/home-fixtures.ts`, a file of its own beside part B's fixtures), the hero's heading a paragraph there so the design page keeps its one `h1`. The plan's data marks decisions 5, 6 and 10 `decided` by their defaults — and, with part C, 7 and 8, which parts B and C built (a static strip of the club's own pictures with a link, the numbers typed and computed) — and phase 3 `building`; `docs/REDESIGN.md` says the same, lists where each part lives (§ Phase 3, part A, as built, and § Phase 3, parts B and C, as built) and how the club turns it on; `docs/VIBECODING.md` has a row.

**Defaults taken (the owner's «the plan's defaults»):** decisions 5, 6 and 10; open questions 6 and 7; the hero's second button is the calendar; the site's own two lines («Alergăm împreună prin Brașov» / "We run together in Brașov" and one sentence under it, from the listing's own «întotdeauna gratuite»); six cards a section.

**What comes next.** Phase 3's gate: the club's photographs (the hero, the covers, the strip) and its words on QA, LCP under 2.5 s on a 320-pixel phone measured there with the club's photograph in the hero, and the club's yes on QA.

**Refused.** A menu entry for the home page (decision 3: the logo leads there). A carousel island (CSS scroll snap; nothing runs in the browser). Stock or generated pictures (decision 6: an empty slot until the club chooses a photograph of its own). Invented figures (the numbers band is part B's, typed or computed, BUSINESS.md §7). Keeping §353's 308 while off (browsers keep it for good, so the switch would not be seen). Reading the setting in the proxy (a database wake per root visit, or a second cache to keep in step). Rendering the listing at the root while off (one page at two addresses, §353's own reason). `next/image` for the pictures (the plan's plain `img` with the ladder). An `h1` for the hero on the design page (one per page). A typed page address for «Cum funcționează» (one address cannot serve both languages). Reading the strip's pictures from the store at each render (the facts in the row, as the hero's). The strip's pictures in the page's own form (a form cannot sit inside another, and an upload would hold the page's boxes). A crop for the strip's tiles (a square of each picture's middle; the cover and the hero keep theirs). An unreadable lower section turning the page off (its empty value instead).

**Verification.** Unit `home/home-page.test.ts` (the sections' rule, the hero's lines, the components from the fixture: one `main`, one `h1`, the empty slots, the kind in words, the arrow inside the one link, the eager hero and the lazy card, no element prop and no colour literal), `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts` (the proxy lets the root through and treats it as static; `/` one hop to `/ro`; the page's temporary redirect, its static config and its canonical), `appearance/site-look-header.test.ts` (the logo's address both ways), `i18n/live-twin.test.ts`, `public-cache/static-public-routes.test.ts` (the root page is static, its links prefetch only static pages), `public-cache/writes-expire-pages.test.ts`, `shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts`, `staff/roles.test.ts`, `notifications/no-hardcoded-values.test.ts` (the title's `{club}` from the constant); integration `appearance/home-page.test.ts` (off with no row, the save, the audit, the picture kept by the sweep and named on the pictures page, every refusal; the buttons and the switches saved, kept by an older form and refused with words and no page; a later release's field carried), `seo/sitemap.test.ts` (the root at priority 1 and the listing at 0.9 while on), `public-cache/home-page-cache.test.ts` (the save seen at the next visit, the last good copy when the database is down); unit `home/home-page.test.ts` also covers the switches, the unset button, the empty section and the tag's scope, and `translate/domain.test.ts` the new names. `scripts/smoke.mjs` carries the root check above. E2E `home-page.spec.ts` (serial, desktop project: off — 307 from `/ro` and `/en`, `/` to `/ro`, the logo to the listing, no root in the sitemap; on — one `h1`, the pill buttons with their arrows at 44 pixels, the empty slot, the sections, nothing sideways at 320 pixels, the canonical and its alternate, the logo to `/ro`, the root in the sitemap, the English page; on with scripts off), against a production build; `client-words.spec.ts` (its root check moved to `home-page.spec.ts`, which switches the shared setting serially) and `header-nav.spec.ts` against the same build. **Part C:** unit `appearance/home-sections-form.test.ts` (every box a pair with one name, its length held to its schema's, the refusal naming the box, the figures read, every English box translatable), `home/home-sections-render.test.ts` (the page draws the four under the run sections in the plan's order only while switched on, the strip only with a picture, the band only with a figure, the strip never eager), `home/home-domain.test.ts` (the strip's pictures with their facts, the arrows' rule), `translate/domain.test.ts`, `shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts` and `public-cache/writes-expire-pages.test.ts` (the strip's three actions and their write), `appearance/home-page-panel.test.ts` (the folds closed on arrival and their summary lines), `scripts/smoke-root.test.ts` (the smoke's verdict on the root: a 307 to the listing and the home page's 200 pass; a 308, a 200 with `__next_error__` and a 200 without the page's marker fail), and in `home/home-domain.test.ts` the numbers band's two narrowings and the steps' titles; integration `appearance/home-page.test.ts` (the lower sections saved, kept by an older form, emptied back to the platform's words, every refusal naming its box; the third button by a page's id, a page that is not the club's refused, an older row's button read as none; the strip's pictures added with their facts, moved, taken out, referenced on the pictures page while in the strip, a second press writing nothing, every refusal, the Administrator's alone). E2E `home-page.spec.ts` switches the lower sections on in their fold and finds «Prima dată», «De ce» and the numbers under the run sections in order (and no strip without a picture), with scripts off too; its weekly-section check no longer depends on an earlier spec having left a weekly series ahead (the sample data has none) — run against a production build with `client-words.spec.ts` and `header-nav.spec.ts`.
changelogLine: - **A home page at the site's root, off until the club switches it on** — «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală», a fold for each part: the hero with the club's photograph (an empty place until one is chosen), two lines and three buttons in both languages, «Următoarea alergare» with the forecast and the sunset, the weekly runs and the special events, then «Prima dată», «De ce» with the club's quote, a strip of up to twelve of the club's photographs and the club's numbers, each switched on when the club has filled it; «Cum funcționează» opens a club page in the reader's language, and a «Copiază și tradu tot» sits over every box. The logo leads to it, the menu does not; off, the site's address still opens «Alergări». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a request to a locale's root (`/ro`, `/en`), when «Pagina principală» is off — the default — then the response is a 307 to that locale's listing, decided by the root's static page rather than the proxy, and the logo links the listing; when it is on, then the root is the home page, canonical to itself with the other locale's root as its alternate, listed in the sitemap at priority 1 (the listing at 0.9), and the logo links it; a request to `/` reaches `/ro` in one redirect, and the deployment's smoke check fails on a root answering anything but that 307 or a 200 whose body is the home page (`data-testid="home-page"`, no `__next_error__`). This replaces criterion 9's 308 (with its kept query and its one hop for `/`, accepted as lost) (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: `yarn smoke`; unit `scripts/smoke-root.test.ts`, `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts`, `appearance/site-look-header.test.ts`; integration `seo/sitemap.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts`.

Given the home page at 320 pixels, when it renders, then it has one `main` and one `h1` (a visually hidden one when the hero is switched off), the hero's two pill buttons and every card's title link are at least 44 pixels tall, the run sections scroll sideways inside themselves with CSS scroll snap and no script, the page never scrolls sideways, and with scripts off it shows the same page; the numbers band counts weekly group runs only, skipping a series whose coming dates are all cancelled (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-page.test.ts`, `home/home-domain.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts`.

Given «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală», when an Administrator saves it, then it is one audited `platform_settings` row — on or off, the hero's photograph as a stored picture of the gallery with its crop (a missing picture or a film's poster refused, the picture kept from the orphan sweep and named on the pictures page), the hero's two lines and its buttons' labels Romanian and English or neither, one side alone refused on the empty side's box, «Cum funcționează» a club page chosen by its id, its words optional, words with no page refused, and drawn only while that page is published, at its own address in each language, and the eight section switches (the first four on, the four lower ones off by default), a section that is off or has nothing to show not drawn; a key this code does not know is kept on read and through a save; an empty pair draws the site's own lines, and no picture draws an empty place, never a stock one; any other role is refused at the action and the service (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `appearance/home-page.test.ts`; unit `staff/roles.test.ts`, `home/home-page.test.ts`, `translate/domain.test.ts`; integration `public-cache/home-page-cache.test.ts`.

Given the home page while «Pagina principală» is on, when it renders, then it carries the club's one `SportsOrganization` block with the root's own address (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: e2e `home-page.spec.ts` (the page), unit `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts` (the page's source).

Given `/admin/design` → «Mostre», when it renders, then it draws `Hero`, `NextRunCard` and `RunCardGrid` — the components the site's root renders — from sample rows that name no person, the hero's heading a paragraph so the page keeps its one `h1` (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-page.test.ts`, `design/design-page.test.ts`.
